newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle firmer in technical correction.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle firmer in technical correction.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures ended higher in a technical correction to an oversold market, analysts said.
Speculative buying, particularly on the close, was noted as most-active January rose close to resistance at 105.00 cents a lb.
January gained 2.65 on the day to close at 104.30, having ranged from 105.00 to 101.00. The back months went out 2.00 firmer to the daily 5.00-cent limit higher.

Fundamental signals also point higher. "The market has been low for this time of year and the crop estimate doesn't justify prices in the low dollar (100.00) range," said Kevin Marshburn, an analyst with Fimat Futures.
In its first estimate for the season, the U.S. Department of Agriculture put the 1996/97 Florida crop at 220 million 90-lb boxes. The estimate was released earlier this month.
